previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of type 1 diabetes, kidney transplant, and recurrent UTIs was admitted with fever, nausea, and foul-smelling urine. She was found to have pyelonephritis due to Klebsiella pneumoniae, mild hyperglycemia with an elevated anion gap, and acute kidney injury likely due to dehydration. She was treated with IV ceftriaxone, then transitioned to oral ciprofloxacin. Her kidney function returned to baseline, infection resolved, and metabolic parameters stabilized. She remained on her home immunosuppressants and chronic medications. She was discharged home with a full course of ciprofloxacin, instructions to hold fosfomycin until completion, and follow-up labs and transplant clinic visit.
problems: Tubulo-interstitial nephritis, not specified as acute or chronic

radiology_notes.text:
ADDENDUM  The left iliac fossa renal transplant was evaluated on this study. 
The right iliac fossa transplant was not evaluated.

EXAMINATION:  RENAL TRANSPLANT U.S.

INDICATION:  History: ___ with LURT in ___ p/w n/v and fevers to 103 with +UA
for UTI// eval for signs of rejection

TECHNIQUE:  Grey scale as well as color and spectral Doppler ultrasound images
of the renal transplant were obtained.

COMPARISON:  Prior ultrasound ___

FINDINGS: 

The right iliac fossa transplant renal morphology is normal.  Specifically,
the cortex is of normal thickness and echogenicity, pyramids are normal, there
is no urothelial thickening, and renal sinus fat is normal.  There is no
hydronephrosis and no perinephric fluid collection.

The resistive index of intrarenal arteries ranges from 0.80 to 0.81,
previously 0.77-0.82, which is slightly elevated but unchanged from multiple
prior studies.  The main renal artery shows a normal waveform, with prompt
systolic upstroke and continuous antegrade diastolic flow, with peak systolic
velocity of 141 centimeters/second near the renal hilum, previously 53.3
centimeters/second.  Vascularity is symmetric throughout transplant. The
transplant renal vein is patent and shows normal waveform.

IMPRESSION:


1. No change in borderline elevated resistive indices throughout the
intrarenal arteries.
2. Otherwise, normal renal transplant ultrasound.
